title: AI Outbound Caller
description: A visual workflow builder for AI outbound calling. Drag-and-drop pipelines chain a trigger to an AI voice call, CRM logging, and status updates, with native HubSpot integration and a live workflow preview.

title: AI Guide Extension
description: A browser extension that walks users through any web app step by step. It highlights the exact element to click, tracks progress through a flow, and uses an LLM to pick the next best action with a live confidence score.

title: Crypto Chiefs
description: A crypto trading intelligence dashboard: real-time prices, technical indicators (EMA, RSI), and long/short trade ideas with live candlestick charts and per-symbol signal flows across 120+ currencies.

title: RIS Intelligence
description: A semantic search and geospatial intelligence platform over German municipal council documents (Ratsinformationssystem). Search by meaning, filter by committee and category, explore results on a map, and query an AI chat across thousands of meeting records.

title: Mental Health Evaluator System
description: Mental Health Evaluator System is built using modern web development tools and libraries to create a responsive and interactive user interface for evaluating mental health conditions.

title: Academy Management System
description: The Academy Management System is a full-stack web application built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js). It is designed to simplify and streamline the management of academic institutions by handling student enrollment, course management, attendance tracking, and more.

title: Inventory Management System
description: This project is an Inventory Management System developed using PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Bootstrap, Font Awesome, and Google Fonts. The system allows administrators to manage products, categories, suppliers, and inventory levels efficiently.

title: Purcity CO2 Calculator
description: Web-Based Platform for calculation COS emissions within a building, and regulating HVACs

title: Hospital Record Management System
description: This project is a Hospital Record Management System developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, PHP, and SQL. The system allows for managing patient records, doctor schedules, appointments, and other hospital-related information.

title: Student Project Partners
description: Student Project Partners is a web application designed to help university students find and manage project partners for their courses. It streamlines the process of collaboration and enhances the academic experience by providing a platform for students to connect based on their courses, programs, and batches.

title: Air Quality Index Prediction
description: This  project aims to develop a robust predictive model for forecasting the Air Quality Index (AQI) using data science techniques.

title: Toon Trails
description: A free roam car driving and character roaming 3D game designed and developed in unity game engine.
